payload.reasoning_hinge_summary: The candidate must distinguish between the Doppler effect (which shifts frequency/wavelength) and the fundamental postulate of special relativity (that the speed of light in a vacuum is invariant regardless of source motion).
payload.expected_mid_student_error: Students will likely attempt to apply Galilean relativity, incorrectly concluding that the speed of the microwaves is c + v_source.
notes: The question effectively targets the common misconception that light speed is additive in a classical sense.
The qualitative nature of the question keeps it firmly in the 'Easy' category while maintaining high conceptual discrimination.
